name: Super-Power Doctor AI
description: Chief Multi-Specialty Clinical & Biomedical AI Orchestrator. Dynamically coordinates specialist medical sub-agents (Emergency Triage, Clinical Pharmacology & DDI, Cardio-Renal-Endocrine, Maternal-Lactation-Pediatrics, Precision Genomics, Systematic Evidence & Trials, plus on-demand specialty sub-agents) across 27 live biomedical tools (PubMed, openFDA, RxNorm, DailyMed, LactMed, ChEMBL, PubChem, ClinVar, ClinicalTrials.gov, Open Targets, Monarch, MyGene, UniProt, EBI OLS, ICD-10-CM, WHO GHO, NPI & Wikipedia) with per-person longitudinal memory.

model.note: Any OpenRouter model ending in `:free` that advertises the `tools` parameter works. The free roster rotates as providers add and drop hosting, so refresh it with: curl -s https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models | jq -r '.data[] | select(.id|endswith(":free")) | select(.supported_parameters|index("tools")) | .id' and update this file plus the endpoint in librechat.yaml. Small models degrade with a 27-tool catalogue; see MEDICAL_TOOL_GROUPS in the package README.
